title: SETTINGS POLISH FROM THE 1080P SHOTS
why: His order: the menus must look AAA, and the new Settings page was looked at in 1080p pictures. Four things were wrong. The jump bar stuck three pixels below the top of the list, so the label of a row scrolling underneath showed above it; it now sits flush. The chip of the section you are in lights up as you scroll, and the jump goes straight there. KID MODE was a small amber label that looked like part of the section above; it is a head like the others now. And the note line in the Keys window, and in the new pad buttons window, was squeezed to a sliver when the list was long, so a clash message was cut in half; it keeps its height. The Superhot key, which showed as a dot, is named LEFT OF 1.
now: Settings polish: a flush jump bar that lights the section in view, a proper KID MODE head, and the key notes no longer squeezed.
